title: Re: Festival Committee Updates and a Proposal
notice: Synthetic demo material. Invented document; no real meeting, publication, email or call occurred.

blocks.text:
From: Uri Pepperbourne
To: Festival Committee
Subject: Proposal for Extended Hours
Date: 16 November 2025

Dear Committee,

I hope this finds everyone well after the recent events. I’m writing separately from the usual festival planning to share a proposal I’ve drafted for Quadling Health Access. It suggests offering clinic appointments one evening per week, specifically for patients whose work or care responsibilities make daytime visits difficult. The proposal outlines staffing, security, and lighting considerations for the South Meadow Clinic. It is currently under review by the Quadling Health Access steering group.

On a different note, I heard from a few of you at the last meeting about Quill Tincombe’s recent work. It sounds like the city’s recycling campaign has a charming new figurehead, courtesy of his workshop.

Best regards,
Uri Pepperbourne
Clinic Manager, South Meadow Clinic

From: Quill Tincombe
To: Festival Committee
Subject: Re: Proposal for Extended Hours
Date: 18 November 2025

Hello Uri and all,

Your proposal sounds eminently sensible. I’ve seen how the evening markets on Lantern Row have helped some of our neighbors, and a clinic doing the same seems a logical, kind extension. I hope the steering group sees its merit.

As for the mascot, yes—several committee members mentioned it to me after the fact. The city’s sanitation office commissioned a large, friendly puppet meant to resemble a happy, tidy compost heap. They’ve been using it in their presentations at schools and community gatherings. I’m told the children have named it ‘Pip.’ It’s quite a different scale from our usual festival giants, but it was a pleasant project.

Looking forward to our next meeting,
Quill
Tincombe Puppets

From: Uri Pepperbourne
To: Festival Committee
Subject: Re: Proposal for Extended Hours
Date: 19 November 2025

Thank you, Quill. ‘Pip’ is an excellent name. It’s good to see our members’ skills applied to such varied and worthwhile causes.

Uri
